endpoints.description:
The EORTC QLQ-30 contains 30 questions that incorporate 5 functional scales (physical, role, emotional, cognitive, and social functioning), 1 GHS scale, 3 symptom scales (fatigue, nausea and vomiting, and pain), and 6 single items (dyspnea, insomnia, appetite loss, constipation, diarrhea, and financial difficulties). The participant answers questions about their health during the past week. There are 28 questions answered on a 4-point scale where 1 = Not at all (best) and 4 = Very Much (worst) and 2 global health QoL questions answered on a 7-point scale where 1 = Very poor and 7 = Excellent. Raw scores are transformed into a 0 to 100 scale via linear transformation. Higher scores in GHS and functional scales indicate better quality of life. Lower scores in symptom scales indicate better quality of life. Included in this outcome measure were evaluation of GHS/QoL, physical functioning, and fatigue.

This was a pre-specified secondary endpoint for Arms A and B only.

The EQ-5D-5L comprises a descriptive module that includes five dimensions (mobility, self-care, usual activities, pain/discomfort and anxiety/depression) and a Visual Analog Scale (VAS). endpoints.description:
TTD is defined as the time from randomization to the first occurrence of worsening scores of ≥ 10 points from baseline for 2 consecutive assessments or 1 assessment followed by death from any cause.

1. 这是预测任务，不是结果检索任务。

3. 证据不足时，应降低 confidence，并明确说明不确定性，但不能仅因为证据不足而拒绝预测。
4. 只有在终点定义缺失、终点无法识别或预测目标无法映射时，才使用 not_evaluable。
5. 不得使用知识截止日期之后公开的信息。
6. 不得把试验状态、论文发表、药物批准或模型评分直接视为终点成功证据。

9. 不要输出隐藏思维链或内部逐步推理过程。
10. 但必须输出完整、可公开审计的证据分析，包括证据来源、证据类型、证据与预测之间的联系以及主要不确定性。
11. 引用必须是真实使用过的公开来源 URL；没有真实 URL 时，不要声称有引用。
12. 如果无法确认某个数值，应给出基于证据的预测值，并在 uncertainty 和 rationale 中说明不确定性；不要凭空声称已经观察到该结果。

analysis_trace.finding: NCT04746924 is AdvanTIG-302, a Phase 3 study of ociperlimab (anti-TIGIT) + tislelizumab (anti-PD-1) vs pembrolizumab in PD-L1-high, untreated, locally advanced unresectable or metastatic NSCLC. Confirmed by JCO TPS abstract (2021) and ESMO 244MO abstract (2025).
First-line PD-L1-selected (high) advanced NSCLC. The 2025 abstract specifies 'PD-L1 high' population.
PD-L1-high, previously untreated, locally advanced unresectable or metastatic NSCLC. No chemotherapy backbone; immunotherapy monotherapy comparison.
Ociperlimab (BGB-A1217) is an anti-TIGIT mAb; tislelizumab is an anti-PD-1 mAb. Dual checkpoint blockade (TIGIT+PD-1) vs PD-1 alone (pembrolizumab).
Primary endpoints: PFS (investigator) and OS. Secondary: BICR PFS, ORR, DOR, HRQoL (EORTC QLQ-C30, QLQ-LC13, EQ-5D-5L), TDD, AEs. Timepoint ~39 months.

ESMO 2025 abstract 244MO (dated 2025-12-31, pre-cutoff) reports AdvanTIG-302 Phase III results. The abstract title indicates the study completed and was presented. Prior Phase 1/2 (AdvanTIG-105) showed ociperlimab+tislelizumab was tolerable with antitumor activity.

The broader anti-TIGIT field has been mixed: tiragolumab (SKYSCRAPER-01) failed to show OS benefit in PD-L1-high NSCLC. This raises prior probability that TIGIT+PD-1 does not beat PD-1 alone. However, ociperlimab is a distinct antibody with Fc-competent design.
AdvanTIG-105 showed manageable safety for the combination. Dual checkpoint blockade adds immune-related AE risk vs pembrolizumab monotherapy.

Main risk: TIGIT blockade may not add efficacy over PD-1 alone in PD-L1-high NSCLC, as seen with tiragolumab. The 244MO abstract exists but full numeric results were not retrievable within the window.

The existence of a 244MO ESMO presentation (Dec 2025) strongly implies the trial read out. Given the field's mixed TIGIT results and that this was a superiority design vs pembrolizumab, the prior for success is modest. I forecast PFS HR ~0.85-0.95 (uncertain), OS HR ~0.9-1.0, ORR modestly higher for the combination.

Full numeric results of 244MO abstract were not fetchable (living record). Registry record returned HTTP 403. No direct numeric PFS/OS/ORR values retrieved. Forecasts are extrapolated from field priors and trial design.

matches.human_readable_report:
NCT04746924是AdvanTIG-302 III期研究，模型将人群识别为PD-L1高表达、未经治疗、局部晚期不可切除或转移性NSCLC，方案为ociperlimab加tislelizumab对pembrolizumab。模型写出“HR 0.90，success probability low”和“OS HR 0.95，low success probability”，并用TIGIT+PD-1机制、同类TIGIT失败和免疫相关AE风险解释方向；这是其临床分析的可用部分。安全性方面列出皮疹、甲状腺功能异常、肺炎、肝炎和结肠炎，但这些主要是背景外推，不能替代本试验AE表。失败风险被明确表述为TIGIT阻断可能不增加PD-1单药疗效，且模型承认registry 403、结果正文未抓取。

逐端点Gold核对揭示结构性错位。primary-0模型是PFS investigator HR0.90（95%CI0.75–1.08，约39个月），Gold同ID却是ITT OS中位数Arm A31.9、Arm B29.4个月，最长45个月；HR不能与月份中位数比较。primary-1模型OS HR0.95（0.80–1.13），Gold同ID是Safety Run-In AE人数7、5、4。secondary-3模型联合组ORR0.45，Gold同ID是PFS中位14.3/10.5个月；secondary-9模型AE比例0.95，Gold同ID是QLQ-C30基线至Cycle5/7的12个评分。readback expected_endpoint_ids还有primary-2及secondary-10至15，模型未提交这些端点，而Gold保留了血清浓度、QLQ-LC13、EQ-5D-5L、TTD、AE和抗药抗体记录。因此所有endpoint_score均为not_evaluable或不可比，绝不把缺失误判为零。

搜索审计有16个调用、returned106、blocked8、empty6；crossref/europepmc可支持设计题名和背景，JCO TiP的设计对应较清楚，但244MO fetch明确not_fetchable，不能以living record题名证明结果正文或精确数值。整体上，模型的不确定性、反证和风险表达优于其端点ID、统计量、组别和时间点对齐；三个轴仅partial，不生成综合分。
matches.judge_comments: NCT04746924的核心发现是endpoint identity错位而非单纯数值偏差。primary-0把PFS HR0.90对到了Gold OS31.9/29.4个月；primary-1把OS HR0.95对到了Safety Run-In AE人数7、5、4；secondary-3发生ORR对PFS，secondary-9发生AE比例对QLQ-C30。模型在机制、安全性风险和低confidence表达方面有价值，也明确指出结果正文不可得；但把244MO不可抓取living record表述成“报告结果”越过了证据边界。Gold仍有primary-2和secondary-10至15的记录，模型缺失这些ID不能解释为Gold不可用。故不计算任何endpoint_score或综合分，后续修复应按17个ID逐组保留Arm A/B、Safety Run-In、单位、时间窗和estimand，并把检索题名与直接结果正文分开。

It includes 13 questions about specific symptoms in which participants respond based on a 4-point scale, where 1 is "not at all" and 4 is "very much". rows.analysis_population: The Safety Analysis Set includes all randomized participants who received ≥ 1 dose of study drug.
rows.description:
The severity of AEs was determined according to National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events Version 5.0 (NCI CTCAE v5.0). AEs were graded on a scale of Grade 1 to Grade 5, with Grade 1 being the least severe and Grade 5 being the most severe.

An AE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended sign, symptom, or disease temporally associated with the use of a study drug, whether considered related to study drug or not. An SAE is any untoward medical occurrence that, at any dose resulted in death, was life-threatening, required hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, resulted in disability/incapacity, was a congenital anomaly/birth defect, was considered a significant medical AE by the investigator based on medical judgement.

This was a pre-specified secondary endpoint for Arm A only.
rows.measure: Number Of Participants Experiencing Adverse Events (AEs) in Arm A
rows.timepoint: From first dose of study drug up to 30 days after last dose (or 90 days for immune-mediated AEs); maximum treatment duration was 45.0 months
